scripts.dev: npm run build -w @routetwin/shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @routetwin/api" "npm run dev -w @routetwin/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @routetwin/shared && npm run build -w @routetwin/api && npm run build -w @routetwin/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @routetwin/shared && npm run test -w @routetwin/api && npm run test -w @routetwin/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @routetwin/shared && npm run typecheck -w @routetwin/api && npm run typecheck -w @routetwin/web
